description: Curated sample of real Soviet/Russian electrical schematics, tiered from simple to complex, for smoke-testing the AVERS pipeline and seeding the v0.3 Active Learning Loop with real-world (non-synthetic) material. See README.md in this folder and docs/REAL_SCHEMATICS_SOURCES.md for the full source catalog and scale-up instructions.
usage_notice: Internal R&D / model evaluation use only. These are scans scraped from public enthusiast/reference sites (not original AVERS works); do not redistribute this folder outside the project. Verify rights before any commercial or public release. See each entry's source_url for attribution.

tiers.description: Clean vector-like tables of individual GOST 2.721-74 УГО symbols (no full schematic context). Useful for sanity-checking symbol classification and as a visual reference for avers/dataset/gost_symbols.py draw functions.

tiers.description: Soviet car wiring diagrams (Э4-like 'connection diagram'): ~50-70 symbols, connector blocks, numbered pins, color-coded wires, ground points. Structurally very close to a small БКС schema (connector_body/pin/junction_dot/ground/wire). Best starting point for real-data fine-tuning before tackling multi-sheet complex diagrams.

tiers.description: Vintage Soviet tube-radio principal schematics (Э3): moderate component density, authentic scan artifacts (noise, skew, faded print) useful for OCR/robustness training, resistor/capacitor/diode symbols close to GOST 2.728/2.730.
